Name: Plantable Trees (CP)
Author: dyanosis
Description:
This is based on [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/3604264]MouseyPounds'[/url] [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/4096]Plantable Palm Trees[/url]. This is a conversion of that mod to only require [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url]﻿﻿. Does not, currently, support trees outside the vanilla Palm Trees. Based on how straight forward this is, I may do this for mushrooms as well since the C# version included it.

[b]Config[/b]
[list]
[*][b]Enabled [/b]- Whether the mod works or not. Default [b]true[/b].
[*][b]Mushrooms As Seeds[/b] - Whether mushrooms (like common/red/purple mushrooms) can be turned into seeds. Default [b]true[/b].
[*][b]Coconuts As Seeds[/b] - Whether Coconuts can be planted. Default [b]true[/b].
[*][b]Desert Palm Tree Plantable [/b]- Whether the Desert Palm Tree will grow when a Coconut is planted. Default [b]true[/b].
[*][b][b]Desert Palm Tree [/b]Fertilizer Chance [/b]- How effective fertilizer is. Default [b].75 [/b](75% chance of each stage completing). Possible values are in quarter percents (.25, .5, .75, 1). I think it works better this way since Palm Trees probably aren't natural to the valley.
[*][b][b]Desert [/b]Palm Trees Can Spread [/b]- Whether Desert Palm Trees produce more trees once grown. Default [b]true[/b].
[*][b]Island Palm Tree Plantable [/b]- Whether the Ginger Island Palm Tree will grow when a Coconut is planted. Default [b]true[/b].
[*][b]Island Palm Tree Fertilizer Chance [/b]- How effective fertilizer is. Default [b].5 [/b](50% chance of each stage completing). Possible values are in quarter percents (.25, .5, .75, 1). I think it works better this way since Palm Trees probably aren't natural to the valley.
[*][b]Island Palm Trees Can Spread [/b]- Whether Ginger Island Palm Trees produce more trees once grown. Default [b]true[/b].
[/list]
All of the values can be manually changed by going to their respective file, which is one of: Desert Palm Tree, Island Palm Tree, Mushroom Tree Seed. Any changes made to the config will not affect already planted/fertilized trees as far as I'm aware.

For example, if you want to only get 2 tree seeds instead of three for common mushrooms + purple mushrooms edit the [b]Mushroom Tree Seed.json[/b] file under [b]Data[/b] and do the following:

Change this:

[b]"Common And Purple Mushroom Tree Seeds": "404 6 422 1/Home/891 3/false/Foraging 7"[/b]

to this:

[b]﻿"Common And Purple Mushroom Tree Seeds": "404 6 422 1/Home/891 2/false/Foraging 7"[/b]

[b]Future Updates:[/b]

I'm thinking about making a new Coconut asset for those who want to be able to know if they're going to grow a Desert Palm Tree or a Ginger Island Palm Tree. Let me know what you think of that in the posts. If you all think you want that, then I'll do it. Probably use [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/5347339]Goldenrevolver[/url] and make a new coconut from coconuts and ginger.

Separates the Desert Palm and Island Palm so you can enable or disable them as plantable (thank you Flor3nce2456 and Goldenrevolver)
